# Tool reference

All **173 tools** exposed by clickup-full-mcp (138 from API v2, 35 from API v3), generated from ClickUp's official OpenAPI specs.

🟢 read-only (GET): 66 · 🟡 write (POST/PUT/PATCH): 78 · 🔴 destructive (DELETE): 29

By default (meta mode) the operations below are reached through `clickup_call_operation` with `{ "name": "<tool>", "arguments": { … } }`; with `CLICKUP_TOOL_MODE=full` each one is registered as its own tool.

How arguments work: path and query parameters go at the top level, JSON request bodies go in `body`, uploads take `file_path` or `file_base64`. See the [main README](../../README.md#how-tools-map-to-the-api).

## Always-available tools

| Tool | Mode | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clickup_request` | full + meta | Raw request to any `/api/v2/` or `/api/v3/` path with the configured token. Disable with `CLICKUP_ENABLE_RAW_REQUEST=false`. |
| `clickup_search_operations` | meta | Search the operations below by keyword and optional toolset. |
| `clickup_describe_operation` | meta | Full description and input schema of one operation. |
| `clickup_call_operation` | meta | Call an operation by name with its arguments. |
